g.text: 1. Only one TVS channel used to minimize capacitance.

g.desc: 1. Only one TVS channel used to minimize capacitance.

g.text: 2. Orient all switches to work in same sense when switching attenuation.

g.desc: 2. Orient all switches to work in same sense when switching attenuation.

g.text: 3. Install bypass resistor in high-pass filter to reduce high-end droop.

g.desc: 3. Install bypass resistor in high-pass filter to reduce high-end droop.

g.text: 4. Transient limiter first stage uses series diodes to increase clamp voltage and reduce capaciatnce.

g.desc: 4. Transient limiter first stage uses series diodes to increase clamp voltage and reduce capaciatnce.
